page.title: Recovery & Events
page.purpose: Explain whether automatic tunnel recovery is healthy, blocked, backing off, or awaiting a guarded operator action.

priorities.statement: The recovery state and next action are unambiguous.
Breaker and backoff risk are visible before a manual force action.
Events explain what changed and whether recovery improved reachability.

states.description: Recovery state and events are loading.
State machine, next action, and event timeline are visible.
No recovery events have occurred; the tunnel is operating normally.
State is available but event history is incomplete.
Last known recovery state remains visible during refresh.
Recovery data failed to load and can be retried.

claims.statement: A force recovery action explains its consequences, current breaker risk, and confirmation requirement before mutation.
